about_the_game:
The Official Soundtrack to A Corgi's Cozy Hike composed by Sam Shandley. Enjoy 12 tracks (+3 Cozier tracks) from our therapeutic adventure. When making the OST, we wanted to encapsulate the spirit of a corgi. It's playful and adventurous, but also heartwarming and cozy.

As with our game, 10% of your purchase will be donated to various animal shelters we work with.

We hope the cozy tunes remind you to live like a dog - enjoy all the little moments and spread love unconditionally.
